description: Returns placed UniFi access points with position, orientation, mounting details, and status. Optionally filter by siteId.

queryParameters.name: siteId
queryParameters.description: Optional UniFi site filter. When set, only devices whose product siteId matches are returned.

children.name: serial
children.description: Device identifier for Hamina import. Uses the MAC address without colons, prefixed with `SN`.

children.name: x
children.description: X coordinate on the floor plan image in pixels.

children.name: y
children.description: Y coordinate on the floor plan image in pixels.

children.name: height
children.description: Mounting height in meters above the floor.

children.name: azimuth
children.description: Antenna orientation in degrees (0–360), derived from device rotation.

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/innerspace/integration/v1/access_points?siteId=%7BsiteId%7D", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: List access points
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.innerspace:
    path: "/v1/access_points"
    method: GET
    query:
      siteId: "{siteId}"
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
